IGF-I and P-III-NP: The QCs shall be prepared either from authentic serum or by spiking a standard solution(s), independent from that used for the calibrator(s), into serum. Following preparation, all QC material shall be aliquoted and stored frozen (preferably at approx. -70 °C or less for long-term storage) until use. At least one (1) serum QC sample representative of the low part of the working range (e.g., at a concentration within the first quartile of the working range) and one (1) serum QC sample representative of the high part of the working range (e.g., at a concentration within the fourth quartile of the working range) shall be used. The QCs may be prepared independently for each Marker or containing both Markers at the appropriate concentrations in a single QC sample. For the CP, at least one QC sample, depending on the initial quantification results for the Markers, shall be included in each confirmatory analytical batch.
